# PhysicsContinuous 〔BlitzLLVM〕

<div align="center">

[Command Index](Command-Index) · [Blitz3D](Blitz3D) · [Physics](Blitz3D-Physics)

</div>


```blitzbasic
PhysicsContinuous:Void entity:Int32, mode:Int32
```

| Parameter | Mode | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `entity` | In | Int32 | required | The body. |
| `mode` | In | Int32 | required | 0 as `PhysicsContinuousDefault` says (default), 1 continuous, 2 never. |

## Description

**〔BlitzLLVM〕** This command does not exist in the original Blitz products. BlitzLLVM adds it.

Chooses whether a fast body is stopped by thin things instead of passing through them. Continuous detection costs more for that body.

## Differences

* The original has no such command. This is an extension; programs that use it do not compile with the original Blitz3D.
